instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Begin a step of my recipe run: get the step with what to do, and when it says it has several agents have each agent's own job started in my own records, in the same call", and give it run (The id of the run's ai-job (ai-job:<recipe id>:<request key>)); step (The id of the step to begin).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:start-a-recipe-step and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Reads the run (the ai-job tool:start-a-recipe-run wrote) and its step.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: ai-job (records:read, records:write).
